0-7-VIGIL.title: Easter Sunday, Vigil
0-7-VIGIL.first: Use at least three, or up to seven readings from the OT, but always include #3: 1) Gen 1:1—2:2 or 1, 26-31a 2) Gen 22:1-18 or 1-2, 9a, 10-13, 15-18 3) Exod 14:15—15:1 4) Isa 54:5-14 5) Isa 55:1-11 6) Bar 3:9-15, 32-4:4 7) Ezek 36:16-17a, 18-28 (diff)
0-7-VIGIL.second: NT Reading: Rom 6:3-11 Response after the Epistle: Psalm 118:1-2, 16-17, 22-23 [refrain: triple "Alleluia"]
0-7-VIGIL.gospel: Gospels for Years A, B, C: A) Matt 28:1-10 B) Mark 16:1-7 (diff) C) Luke 24:1-12
